title: Anchor for VP08. A cut-stone wall meeting a dark plinth, moss and a plank at the origin: four materials in one frame at half a metre.
note: Named states double as the viewpoint anchors in tools/harness/viewpoints.json: shoot.mjs calls loadState(viewpoint.anchor) before posing the camera, so every anchor id MUST be a loadable state or the viewpoint is unshootable and the metric it feeds scores 0, fail-closed (HARNESS.md §6). This state toggles the materialShowcase prop group.
